name: Kurrier Self-Hosted Workspace
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted software for unified email, calendars, contacts and WebDAV/S3 storage; no software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Bring your own IMAP/SMTP or email delivery provider, storage, database and server. Provider fees and infrastructure are not included. Modified network deployments must comply with AGPL source-sharing obligations.
